name: oliyugam-studio-monitor
description: Windows-first Electron foundation for Oliyugam Studio Monitor

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:main" "pnpm run launch:dev"
scripts.launch:dev: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main.cjs dist/preload.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config config/electron-builder.yml
